name: Refex Industries Ltd
title: Refex Industries Ltd - 532884 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Refex's ash & coal handling service mix lifted Q4 EBITDA margin to 20.1% on revenue of INR701 crores, but FY26 revenue fell to INR2,039 crores from INR2,259 crores and wind is only just ramping (EBITDA ~8%).
